div.head: Iud Dei XII 19.1
div.ab: et si aliquis hanc presentem examinationem per aliquod maleficium aut per herbas terrę tegere et impedire uoluerit, tua sancta dextera, iustissime Iudex, euacuare digneris. Per dominum

div.ab: and if anyone wishes to cover and hinder this present examination through any sorcery or through herbs of the earth, may you, most just Judge, deign to make it void with your holy right hand. Through our Lord
